title: Cottage Cheese Protein Pasta Bake
seoTitle: Cottage Cheese Protein Pasta Bake | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: High-protein baked penne with marinara and melted mozzarella
subtitle: High-protein baked penne with marinara and melted mozzarella
description: Blended cottage cheese creates a high-protein sauce layered with penne, marinara, and part-skim mozzarella. Bakes in a deep hotel pan for easy hold.

steps.title: Par-cook penne
steps.instruction: Boil penne in salted water 7–8 minutes until flexible but still firm in the center. Drain well so excess water does not thin the bake.

steps.title: Blend cottage cheese sauce
steps.instruction: Blend cottage cheese, eggs, garlic, basil, oregano, salt, and pepper until completely smooth with no curd texture remaining.

steps.title: Layer pasta and sauces
steps.instruction: Toss penne with cottage cheese mixture and half the marinara in a large bowl until evenly coated and glossy.

steps.title: Assemble and top with cheese
steps.instruction: Spread half the pasta in a greased hotel pan. Drizzle remaining marinara, then top with remaining pasta and mozzarella-parmesan blend.

steps.title: Bake until bubbling
steps.instruction: Bake at 375°F for 30–35 minutes until edges bubble and cheese turns golden brown with a few crisp spots on top.

proTips: Blend cottage cheese while cold—warm curds resist smoothing.
Add sautéed spinach or roasted red peppers for color and fiber without changing bake time.
Portion with a square cutter for uniform macros across the crew.
tonightSpread: Steamed broccoli with lemon and chili flakes.
leftovers: Reheat squares covered with foil; add splash of marinara to restore moisture.
Cut cold leftovers into meal-prep cubes for shift lunches.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Mac-and-cheese energy with better macros. One pan feeds the whole hall and slices into clean portions.
mealPrepNotes: Blend cottage cheese smooth ahead of time. Undercook penne by 2 minutes—it finishes in the oven. Station: Use a 4-inch deep hotel pan so the bake holds heat without drying at the edges. Station: Tent foil first 20 minutes, uncover last 10 for golden cheese without overcooking pasta. Station: Rest pan 10 minutes before cutting so layers set and portions stay intact.
